paragraphs: I would rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their actual deliverable today than present a polished deck about what is theoretically possible next quarter. That is not a value I am adopting for this role - it is how I have operated on every project I have shipped.

At Formula Dream I sat with the content team, mapped the full manual workflow - race event to published post - identified the highest-leverage transformation points, and built the replacement: event detection, API ingestion, headless rendering, LLM inference, n8n orchestration, auto-publish across platforms. Zero manual steps. Then I documented it as a reusable pattern so the same architecture could scale to any recurring event without rebuilding. At Think Round Inc I partnered with product and operational teams, built working agents in days, coached the team through adoption from first win to self-sufficiency, and documented the tools and patterns so other teams could access them without starting from scratch. SceneAgent: identified a gap, shipped a working agentic platform in 48 hours, designed as a reusable pattern across multiple domains.

I am a pattern recogniser. When something works for one workflow, I immediately see how it applies to others. I build in real time alongside people. I use Claude Code and Cursor daily. I explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders - because the adoption side matters as much as the build side.
